images.alt: The FSP Hydro G 750W came through our testing as a real winner and something that will provide FSP with a solid platform to be competitive with in this very crowded market.

The FSP Hydro G 750W is a technically capable design with a 5 year warranty and a solid internal design. The chassis is well finished and the multicoloured replaceable sticker system is certainly interesting.
The FSP Hydro G 750W Power Supply is affordable, offers excellent power, has Japanese capacitors, is 100% modular, includes a quiet FSB 135mm fan, comes with a 5 year warranty and looks awesome.

Low load efficiency was impressive as heck, ripple control was excellent, and voltage stability was quite good indeed. Add to that the semi-fanless mode with an FDB fan and some extra stickers in case you don't like the default ones, and you have a great value in a really good power supply. Well done, FSP.
It would mostly match the needs of those that want a product that combines aesthetics with good overall performance focused on low noise operation.

C’est bien beau de tester de la grosse alimentation, des versions platinums qui sont certes au top mais coûtent aussi quelques semaines de travail. Alors pourquoi ne pas faire la mixité entre une alimentation haut de gamme et un modèle à prix abordable ?
Le G signifie « Gold », en rapport à son rendement 80 + certifié Or, et signifie également gamer, le public visé par ce bloc. Mais pour « Hydro » c'est moins intuitif.

The Hydro-G line of power supply units is the latest one to roll out from FSP and as many of you have probably figured out by now it's aimed primarily towards demanding gamers since not only is it fully modular (future proof really since you can swap the 24pin mainboard power cable for the new one.
